omar (Eng Manager): Quick check: we need to change base comp for an internal transfer that completed last week. Offer accepted and paperwork done. Is there a path to adjust without rescinding?
maya (People Ops): You can request an adjustment but we prefer not to resend offers. Submit /forms/comp-change-request with 'internal transfer' and include original offer docs + reason for change.
sasha (Compensation): If change is to correct an error (e.g., wrong band applied) mark it as "Correction" — those are fast-tracked. If it's an up-tier request for retention, it follows outside-cycle promo rules and may need budget sign-off.
omar (Eng Manager): The employee started Monday and manager wants a $10k uplift due to widened scope. Is retro pay full-month?
finance-helper: Retro pay processed per payroll cutoffs (10th). If approved before cutoff, first payroll will include retro; otherwise next month. Also note tax withholdings apply.
nina (HRBP): For transfers, also verify benefits effective date — benefits team needs the correct effective date for deductions.
cal (Recruiting): Please don't update offer email templates directly. We'll coordinate messaging if comp changes. Recruiting will help draft communication if needed.
omar (Eng Manager): Any constraints on changing equity after transfer?
sasha (Compensation): Equity generally follows the original grant schedule. If you want to increase equity as part of adjustment, it requires Total Rewards and committee approval — longer lead time.
maya (People Ops): Managers: checklist for transfers needing comp change: 1) /forms/comp-change-request 2) attach offer docs + manager justification 3) director sign-off 4) budget owner pinged if >$15k ARR impact 5) Recruiting looped for messaging 6) Benefits cc'd for effective date handling.
omar (Eng Manager): Great, i'll prep packet. If we need to escalate, who signs as exec sponsor?
maya (People Ops): Exec sponsor usually the VP of Eng or the hiring org VP. If you think this will set precedent, talk to your director first and loop People Ops.
sasha (Compensation): Note: if change would cause internal parity issues we'll propose alternatives like spot bonuses or phased increases.
finance-helper: Ping me before submission if you want a quick budget sanity check.
omar (Eng Manager): thanks team. I'll gather evidence and submit the form today.
maya (People Ops): Thanks Omar. Posting this checklist in the manager playbook later today."
